ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: To which organ is the appendix attached to?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows the digestive system with labeled parts. Near the lower left of the abdomen, the label “Appendix” points to a small worm-like projection attached to the pouch labeled “Cecum.” The cecum is connected to the colon labels such as ascending colon, transverse colon, descending colon, and sigmoid colon. Reasoning: The appendix is shown attached to the cecum, and the cecum/colon is part of the large intestine. Therefore, the organ the appendix is attached to is the large intestine.
